message.content:
This editorial illustration features a red background with several distinct graphic elements. A large, yellow, circular object resembling an ancient coin with central square cutouts and stylized script is positioned at the top left. This coin has a serrated, gear-like outer edge. A similar, larger yellow gear-like shape extends from the coin's edge down towards the bottom center.

Intertwined with this lower gear is a stylized dragon. The dragon has a black and yellow scaled body, a golden mane, and two visible claws. Its body curves in a large "S" shape, with its head at the top right, facing left. The dragon’s body appears to be emerging from or wrapping around the gear.

Large white text at the top reads "TEMPO," with smaller text above it saying "CERITA DARI PENJARA ROSA." Below the main title is "EDISI 23-29 JANUARI 2012." At the bottom right, white and yellow text reads "LIPUTAN KHUSUS KAPITALISME BUATAN CINA." Other small text includes "MAJALAH BERITA MINGGUAN," a price "Rp 27.000," and a barcode at the bottom left.
